data.long_meaning: Lioriah is a Hebrew name meaning 'Light of the Lord'. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'YHWH' (Yahweh), meaning 'God', and the Hebrew word 'ior' (light). In the Bible, the name Liorah is not directly mentioned, but it can be inferred from the name Eliorah, which means 'My God is light'. The name Lioriah carries the meaning “Light of the Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lioriah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
